snippet.title: Mutiny's Wake - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4119820/Mutinys_Wake/
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/YfGsQ5FV6Q
Release Date: May 14th 2026

Mutiny’s Wake is a survival game set during the Golden Age of Piracy, where a mutiny leaves survivors stranded on a hostile island with limited resources and constant danger.

After your ship crashes, you wash ashore with nothing. The island is occupied by pirates fighting over what little remains. Resources do not respawn, every decision matters, and survival depends on planning, awareness, and knowing when to fight.

Scavenge, hunt, build a base, and craft tools, weapons, clothing, traps and ships. Hide from pirates or kill them to steal their resources. Wildlife is just as dangerous, with cougars and panthers roaming the island.

The island holds dangerous locations and rare opportunities. A sealed cave hides valuable resources and deadly threats. Wrecks, docks, and taverns controlled by pirates offer supplies, if you survive long enough to take them. A heavily armed ship occasionally patrols the waters, threatening player vessels but rewarding those who manage to sink it.

Play solo or with others in peer-to-peer multiplayer for up to 8 players.

Progression is blueprint-based, with crafting blueprints unlocked through levelling, allowing you to specialize your approach to survival.

Key Features:
-Hardcore survival with limited non-respawning resources
-PvP and PvE on a shared pirate-controlled island
-Dangerous wildlife
-Base building and raiding
-Crafting system for tools, structures, weapons, clothing, traps, ships, and cannons
-High-risk locations and events with valuable rewards
-Solo and multiplayer gameplay
